text:
maria: Quick q — getting a few 401s hitting the hosted API from our Node client. Dug in and it's a subtle env var issue: users saving the key into a file with a trailing newline. When we do `Buffer.from(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY + ':').toString('base64')` the extra \n ruins the header. Anyone seen/handled this?

maria: repro snippet:
```js
const auth = Buffer.from(`${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}:`).toString('base64')
await axios.post(url, body, { headers: { Authorization: `Basic ${auth}` } })
```

sam: yep seen it before. common when people `echo key > ~/.redwood_key` or copy from mac clipboard. quick fix is `process.env.REDWOOD_KEY?.trim()` on read. :thumbsup:

jess: windows CRLF also bites here — `\r` stays and base64 different. we added this in an internal helper: `key.replace(/\r|\n/g, '')` so it tolerates both.

alex: curious if SDK should auto-trim or just document it. silent mutation of token feels risky but also UX bad to 401 on copy/paste. maybe warn once and trim?

sam: +1 for trim-with-warning. we can log a single-time warning: "Found trailing whitespace in REDWOOD_KEY; trimming for compatibility." and expose an opt-out like `REDWOOD_SDK_TRIM_KEYS=false`.

maria: agree. can we avoid trimming internal whitespace though? someone could theoretically have spaces. so only trim leading/trailing and strip CR/LF, not collapse internal spaces.

jess: exactly — do `trim()` and then `.replace(/\r|\n/g, '')` before base64. add unit tests for a token with internal spaces to verify we don't touch it.

alex: created a tiny PR scaffold: https://git.redwood/internal/redwood-sdk-js/pull/412 — trims by default and logs a dev-mode warning. deploy-bot: created pr #412 in redwood-sdk-js to trim REDWOOD_KEY by default and emit one-time warning (opt-out via env var).

maria: awesome. can you add the same behavior to python and go SDKs? users hit different languages.

sam: will do JS + Py today. jess will take Go. i'll add tests for: trailing LF, trailing CRLF, token-with-space, and empty env var.

alex: also update quickstart docs: add note about `pbcopy`/`pbpaste` and `tr -d '\\r\\n'` example for saving keys in CI. e.g. `export REDWOOD_KEY=$(cat keyfile | tr -d '\\r\\n')`.

maria: thanks team. follow-ups: add changelog entry, backport to earlier SDK branch, and mark as docs tweak for quickstart. closing once PRs merge. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: PR #412 merged to main and will be in next patch release. CI green.

maria: lovely — marking this resolved for now. if customers still hit it we can switch to stricter validation + helpful error message with link to docs.

sam: note: be careful with trimming in server-side envs where keys are templated — added feature flag to be safe.

jess: added unit tests and a tiny integration test against staging that sends a key with CRLF — all good.

maria: thanks everyone, closing thread.
